Thanks for the details — that percent-encoded sequence (%C3%A1) is UTF-8 for 'á'. It looks like Gmail/clients are breaking or truncating the query string when certain special characters are present and Ariba is rejecting the truncated token.

Actions taken:
- Re-issued a new invite from our side after normalizing the organization slug to remove non-ASCII characters (Novatronics). New invite sent to elena@novatronics.com with short token.
- Generated a one-time manual activation token and applied it directly in Ariba for the Novátronics vendor record (so Elena can sign in immediately).
- Filed internal ticket JIRA-SUP-1239 to implement server-side URL normalization for future invites and to detect percent-encoded sequences that exceed safe length.

Elena: you should receive the new invite within 5 minutes. If you still see anything odd, reply and we'll activate manually again. Sorry for the churn — we'll follow up after we confirm you can accept POs.
